questions.question: According to the paper, what did Open Babel version 2.3 interconvert?
questions.reference_answer: It interconverted over 110 chemical file formats.
questions.source_quote: Open Babel version 2.3 interconverts over 110 formats.

questions.question: Name two utilities, other than format conversion, that Open Babel provides according to the paper.
questions.reference_answer: Conformer searching and 2D depiction. Other supported examples include filtering and substructure or similarity searching.
questions.source_quote: a variety of useful utilities from conformer searching and 2D depiction

questions.question: Which two molecular modalities does CMMS-GCL use to extract molecular features?
questions.source_quote: two modality data, i.e. SMILES sequence and molecule graph

questions.question: What prediction task was CMMS-GCL developed to address?
questions.reference_answer: Prediction of the metabolic stability of drug candidates.
questions.source_quote: CMMS-GCL for predicting the metabolic stability of drug candidates

questions.question: What shared train, validation, and test split should be used for a joint benchmark of Open Babel and CMMS-GCL?
questions.reference_answer: Insufficient information: neither paper defines a shared benchmark or joint train/validation/test split across these two systems.
questions.source_anchor: Corpus-level negative control; not specified in either selected article.
